title: Dashboard overview
description: Understand your home dashboard, stats, and quick actions after signing in.

sections.heading: What you’ll see
paragraphs: Your dashboard is the starting point after login. It surfaces progress, recent activity, and shortcuts to tests and study tools.
Students see learning-focused cards (tests, performance, certificates). Instructors see workspace shortcuts to create tests, batches, and reports.

sections.heading: Tips
bullets: Use the sidebar to jump to any major area without returning here.
Your role (student, instructor, admin) controls which pages are available.
Use the refresh icon in the header to reload data across the app.

title: How to create tests
description: Build exams with AI assistance, upload sources, and configure timing and proctoring.

sections.heading: Getting started
paragraphs: Go to **Create test** from the sidebar or instructor hub. You can describe what you want to assess, upload a PDF for parsing (when supported), and set subject, difficulty, and question count.

sections.heading: Configuration
bullets: Set time per question or total duration where applicable.
Enable proctoring if you need tab-focus and violation tracking.
Choose whether students see answers after submission and if reattempts are allowed.
Optionally set an expiry date for access to the test.

sections.heading: After creation
paragraphs: You can edit questions in the question editor, regenerate individual items, and invite students when the test is ready.

title: How to manage tests
description: Edit, delete, invite learners, and review high-level stats from one place.

sections.heading: All tests / My tests
paragraphs: Open **All tests** from the sidebar. Instructors see tests they own; students see assigned and personal tests depending on your setup.

sections.heading: Actions
bullets: **Edit** opens settings and content for tests you own.
**Invite** sends email invites when your workflow uses invitations.
**Report** opens analytics and candidate detail for that exam.
**Delete** removes a test you own (often with a confirmation dialog).

title: How to invite students
description: Send invites by email, bulk file, or batch so learners can access your tests.

sections.heading: Single or bulk email
paragraphs: From the instructor hub or test card, choose **Invite**. Enter one email, or switch to bulk upload and use a spreadsheet with addresses (supported formats are indicated in the UI).

sections.heading: Invite by batch
bullets: Select an existing **batch** (group) to invite every member at once.
Ensure students have accounts or can complete signup from the invite link if your flow requires it.

sections.heading: Tracking
paragraphs: Reports show who was invited, who accepted, and outcomes per candidate. Detailed views still list every attempt.

title: How to create batches
description: Organize students into groups for shared invites, messaging, and shared exams.

sections.heading: Create a batch
paragraphs: Open **Batches** in the sidebar. Create a new batch with a clear name, then add members by email or invite links depending on your permissions.

sections.heading: Using batches
bullets: Invite a whole batch to a test instead of typing emails one by one.
Use batch context for communication where the product supports it.
Manage membership from the batch detail screen.

title: How to view reports
description: Read exam-level summaries, per-student outcomes, and export-friendly detail.

sections.heading: Exam report
paragraphs: From **Test reports** or a test’s **Report** button, open the exam report. Summary cards show invites, attempts, pass/fail, and averages based on unique learners (latest attempt where noted).

sections.heading: Candidate detail
bullets: Open a student to see attempts, scores, and question-level breakdown when available.
Screenshots may appear if proctoring capture is enabled for that exam.

title: How to evaluate answers
description: Review subjective items, adjust scoring when allowed, and use AI-assisted feedback.

sections.heading: Student report view
paragraphs: In the per-student report, review each question. Where the product allows, you can override correctness or scores and save—updates refresh the displayed result.

sections.heading: Best practices
bullets: Align overrides with your institution’s policy.
Use notes or feedback fields when present so learners understand changes.
Re-run exports or notifications only if your workflow includes them.

title: Taking an exam
description: Start a test, follow proctoring rules, submit, and view your result.

sections.heading: Before you start
bullets: Stable internet and a quiet environment help avoid proctoring flags.
Read the instructions and time limits shown on the start screen.

sections.heading: During the exam
paragraphs: Answer questions in order or navigate using the question list if provided. Avoid switching tabs if proctoring warns against it.

sections.heading: After submission
paragraphs: You’ll see your score and explanations depending on instructor settings. Certificates may generate automatically when you pass and the exam allows them.

title: Study mode & flashcards
description: Practice with flashcards and review modes from the Tests page when enabled.

sections.heading: Opening study mode
paragraphs: From **My tests**, pick a test and use **Study** when available. Modes depend on what the instructor enabled (flashcards, review, etc.).

sections.heading: Tips
bullets: Study mode does not replace the graded exam—passing still requires the formal attempt if required.
Use filters and search on the tests list to find content quickly.

title: Certificates
description: Earn, download, and verify certificates after passing eligible exams.

sections.heading: Students
paragraphs: Open **Certificates** to see earned credentials. Download PDFs and share verify links or QR codes where shown.

sections.heading: Instructors
paragraphs: Instructors typically manage issuance through reports and student outcomes; student certificates issued for your tests may appear in the student-certificates view where enabled.

title: Leaderboard & performance
description: Compare progress and review your own analytics over time.

sections.heading: Leaderboard
paragraphs: The public leaderboard shows rankings based on platform rules (e.g. XP or scores). Availability may depend on your organization’s settings.

sections.heading: Performance page
paragraphs: Your **Performance** view summarizes attempts, trends, and weak areas where the product surfaces them—use it to prioritize practice.

title: Profile & settings
description: Update your account, password, plan visibility, and preferences.

sections.heading: Profile
bullets: Change display name and review email where editable.
Upgrade plan links appear when your organization uses paid tiers.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: Use a strong password and complete password reset via **Forgot password** if you lose access.

title: Pricing & plans
description: Understand tiers, limits, and where to upgrade.

sections.heading: Plans
paragraphs: Visit **Pricing** from the marketing navigation or footer. Plans may cap exams per month, features like AI generation, or instructor capabilities.

sections.heading: Billing
paragraphs: Payment flows (e.g. cards) are handled on the checkout screens linked from pricing. Contact support for invoicing if your contract requires it.

title: Tickets & support
description: Open requests and track responses when something breaks or you need help.

sections.heading: Ticketing
paragraphs: Use **Ticketing** from the sidebar footer area to create a ticket. Describe steps, expected vs actual behavior, and attach screenshots if useful.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For general inquiries, the **Contact** page may reach your operators directly—use whichever channel your organization prefers.

title: Notifications
description: Stay informed about invites, batches, and system messages.

sections.heading: Bell menu
paragraphs: Click the notification bell in the header to read and dismiss items. Important invites may appear here as well as in email.

title: Admin panel overview
description: High-level platform management for administrators.

sections.heading: Access
paragraphs: Admins open **Admin** from the sidebar to manage users, plans, announcements, logs, and system settings—depending on deployment configuration.

sections.heading: Guidelines
bullets: Restrict destructive actions to trusted operators.
Review audit logs where available before sensitive changes.

title: Instructor hub
description: Central place for instructors to jump to creation, tests, reports, and invites.

sections.heading: Navigation
paragraphs: The instructor dashboard lists your tests with summary stats (unique students, pass/fail, not attempted). Use **Report** for deep dives per exam.

sections.heading: Shortcuts
bullets: **Create test** for new exams.
**Test reports** for aggregate analytics.
**Batches** for groups and batch invites.

title: Proctoring basics
description: What proctoring monitors and how to avoid violations.

sections.heading: Behavior
paragraphs: When enabled, the exam may warn or terminate after repeated tab switches, idle periods, or other rules configured for your deployment.

sections.heading: Candidates
bullets: Keep one window focused on the exam.
Avoid copy/paste unless explicitly allowed.
Contact your instructor if you believe a flag was incorrect.

title: Understanding your results
description: Read score breakdowns, explanations, and certificate eligibility.

sections.heading: After submit
paragraphs: The results page shows total score, pass/fail vs the passing threshold, and per-question feedback when the instructor allows it.

sections.heading: Reattempts
paragraphs: If reattempts are enabled, you may start again from **My tests** until limits or expiry apply.

title: Verify a certificate
description: Anyone can validate a certificate ID or QR code.

sections.heading: Public verify
paragraphs: Use the verify URL or scan the QR from a PDF. The page confirms issuance details when the certificate exists and is active.
